name: Chase Desk
office_task: Every morning, rank who owes us by what is at risk, chase only those the rules allow, record each promise as a date, and hand disputes to a named person.
systems_of_record: Xero (the ledger that issues the invoice_id, its contacts and its invoice history)
the job system named on the invoice (ServiceM8, Simpro), read by job_id only

emits.write: a dated promise to pay on the invoice in the ledger: the date (required), the amount (empty when none was said), the method if offered and when it was captured; the promised date becomes the invoice's follow-up date, and a logged dispute is never overwritten
emits.readback: the promise is read back from the ledger by invoice_id (Xero: GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{InvoiceID} returns ExpectedPaymentDate, and GET .../Invoices/{InvoiceID}/History returns the promise note); no read-back means promise_write_failed is raised and no promise.recorded

emits.write: an exception on the invoice's record naming the person who owns it: a dispute named on a call or already logged, a relationship-sized balance, hardship stated, no date given, an override with no named approver, or a promise that did not read back
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the invoice_id, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
